title: Replace test-tone fallbacks with BackendUnavailable
description: The CLI copies of higgs, chatterbox and fish (and any other backend) return a 440 Hz tone on ImportError or on non-Apple machines. Raise a typed `BackendUnavailable` that names the missing dependency.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Finding while verifying A1: `tts_backends.feature` and `tts_pluggable.feature` both have an untagged 'Job requests the Higgs backend' scenario that calls the real worker-image Higgs `generate`. In CI it passes only because of the silent test-tone fallback. On a Mac with the model libraries installed it loads the 4B model and hung past 20 minutes. Once the fallback is removed, tag those scenarios `@integration` (or point them at the fake backend).
